subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: What public reset-start policy should OpenClaw expose for bare `/new` and `/reset` across static acknowledgements, startup/model turns, prompt text, greeting suppression, and optional cheaper greeting-model routing?
rationale: The remaining work adds compatibility-sensitive config and changes session-start/model-routing semantics, so automation should not invent the key shape or default behavior.

options.title: Add Explicit Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Keep the current acknowledgement behavior unless maintainers choose otherwise, and add one typed opt-in policy for startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing.

options.title: Restore Startup Turns By Default
options.body: Make bare resets run the startup/model turn again and explicitly accept the token-cost, latency, and upgrade behavior change.

options.title: Defer New Reset Controls
options.body: Keep current ack-only behavior and use `/new <message>` plus the narrower reset-prompt tracker until a broader reset policy is approved.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Keep the current acknowledgement behavior unless maintainers choose otherwise, and add one typed opt-in policy for startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing.

likelyOwner.reason: The current acknowledgement-only reset contract and prior policy review both route most directly through this recent reset-contract history.
